package rulefixtures

import "os"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_io_operations_small_writes_without_bufio_writer: Layer: I/O operations. Flag many Write calls to files or network connections without bufio buffering.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario551Positive(path string, records []string) error {
	f, _ := os.Create(path)
	defer f.Close()

	// Each small Write call triggers a syscall. No bufio.Writer is
	// used to batch writes, causing high per-write overhead.
	for _, rec := range records {
		if _, err := f.Write([]byte(rec + "\n")); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
